milkyWay.projection: equirectangular, J2000 equatorial; u = 0.5 - RA/360 (mod 1), so the centre column is RA 0h and RA increases to the left; v = (90 - Dec)/180 from the top row (north) down

encoding.decode: linear = (texel / 255)^2 * white, per channel, the texel read without any colour-space conversion

milkyWay.scaleNote: luminance in cd/m2 = scaleCdM2 * (0.2126 R + 0.7152 G + 0.0722 B) of the decoded linear value

calibration.anchor: integrated starlight near the north galactic pole = 39.0 S10 (Leinert et al. 1998, A&AS 127, 1)

layers: milkyway_2020_4k.exr (Milky Way background, every Hipparcos and Tycho star omitted)
hiptyc_2020_4k.exr (Hipparcos and Tycho stars) with the stars of stars.bin masked out

moon.projection: equirectangular selenographic; u = (longitude + 180)/360, east to the right, centre column 0 degrees; v = (90 - latitude)/180 from the top row (north) down

source.product: NASA SVS CGI Moon Kit (item 4720), LROC colour map, 2025 version
